parts.text:
Here are the official and secure links to log in to your Microsoft account:

*   **Main Microsoft Account Dashboard:** [account.microsoft.com](https://account.microsoft.com/)
*   **Direct Sign-In Page:** [login.live.com](https://login.live.com/)

### How to Sign In:
1. Click one of the links above.
2. Enter your email address, phone number, or Skype name associated with your Microsoft account, then click **Next**.
3. Enter your password and click **Sign in**. 

### Troubleshooting & Support:
*   **Forgot your password?** You can reset it directly by going to [Reset your Microsoft Account Password](https://account.live.com/password/reset).
*   **Forgot your username/email?** Go to the sign-in page, click **Sign-in options**, and select **Forgot my username**.
*   **Can't sign in at all?** Use the official [Microsoft Sign-In Helper](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/account-billing/i-can-t-sign-in-to-my-microsoft-account-475c9b5c-8c25-49f1-9c2d-c25270b98842) to diagnose the issue.

*⚠️ **Security Tip:** Always ensure the website address in your browser's address bar starts with **`https://login.live.com/`** or **`https://account.microsoft.com/`** before entering your password or security details to protect against phishing.*
